Overview

Stoke-on-Trent is a city in England with a population of 373,000. The World Capital of Ceramics, a historic pottery city in the Midlands known for its six towns, the Wedgwood brand, and the Alton Towers theme park nearby. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 142 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
